summary: Two tubing teens went over a low-head dam by Watson Lake on the Cache la Poudre near the 4800 block of Rist Canyon Road; a 16-year-old stuck in the dam was pulled ashore with a rope, alert, and transported to Poudre Valley Hospital; an 18-year-old was pulled unresponsive downstream, received bystander CPR, and was airlifted by UCHealth LifeLine to Medical Center of the Rockies in Loveland, condition unknown; neither wore a PFD.
location: Cache la Poudre River, low-head dam by Watson Lake, 4800 blk Rist Canyon Rd
notes: 911 call ~5:30 p.m. Sunday; article says 'Sunday evening'. Run 651.
